title: The Brimstone Lift
text: A cage on a black chain goes down into the Pit, swaying in the hot updraft, worked by an imp at a winch who has not stopped grinning since you arrived. It holds four, the imp says, and the slowest will have to wait for the next one.

options.label: Ride the swaying cage down, and try not to look at the imp's grin.

outcomes.text: The ride is fast and very hot. The imp is still grinning when you reach the bottom, and you do not want to know why.

options.label: The slowest takes the stairs alone, rather than wait for the imp's next ride.

outcomes.text: They arrive much later, singed, limping and furious, with stories to tell.

options.label: Throw the imp off its winch. Nothing that grins like that can be trusted.

outcomes.text: It falls a long way, still grinning. Its friends below heard it land.
